facts.fact: Angola's national procurement service director said the Sistema Nacional da Contratação Pública Electrónica, launched in April 2018, has processed public purchases online, with over 400 state suppliers on the system.
facts.system: Sistema Nacional da Contratação Pública Electrónica (SNCPE)

facts.fact: The Serviço Nacional da Contratação Pública director said SNCPE has run 1,959 tender procedures since 2018 and saved Kz 110 billion (25%) against estimated values.
facts.system: Sistema Nacional da Contratação Pública Electrónica (SNCPE)
